3455-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2403-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-2403-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

2981-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
2981-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
2981-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

424-868-8213.description:
Cast Cranial Extraction by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Cranial Extraction.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Cranial Extraction, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting an opponent.
Resolve Cranial Extraction, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

512-3814-7014.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-3814-7014.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-3814-7014.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

5961-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
5961-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

394-586-864-3125-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5686-7084-7893.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-1733-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available, {3}{U} each turn
1446-1733-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Nephalia Smuggler by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4350-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
4350-6797-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

647-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

427-1781-1978.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.
427-1781-1978.description:
Cause Kydele to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-2416-3053.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-2416-3053.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Rise and Shine.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

779-4970-5751-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
779-4970-5751-6747.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1305-1753-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

1308-3951-4452-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
1308-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-1315-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-1315-5531-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1315-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

2-1636-6406.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Ancestral Statue between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
2-1636-6406.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
2-1636-6406.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

1548-2034-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1548-2034-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Port Razer, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1170-2104-6333.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
1170-2104-6333.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

4094-5636-5742-5743.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4094-5636-5742-5743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4508-4772-4875-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3604-4659-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
3604-4659-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat from step 3.
3604-4659-5365.notes:
You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

5256-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5256-5776-5777.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

1295-1986-2503.description:
Activate Titan's Nest by exiling a card from your graveyard, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast a colored spell that does not have {X} in its mana cost.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

276-1063-1633-2060-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Oskar triggers if the discarded card was a nonland card.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler;s first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, choosing to cast Hanabi Blast if it was the discarded card by paying {1}{R}{R} targeting Crystalline Crawler, or choosing not to cast the card otherwise.
If you did not cast Hanabi Blast using Oskar, cast it from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

1308-1651-4330.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
1308-1651-4330.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1812-2005-4893.notablePrerequisites: Jetfire has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1812-2005-4893.description:
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} and converting it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Prismite three times by paying {3}, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {U}{U}{U}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Repeat.

1636-4117-5038.notablePrerequisites: Visara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4117-5038.description:
Activate Visara by tapping it, destroying any nontoken creature.
The creature dies, triggering Overseer of the Damned, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent control.

1687-3129-4050-4124.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

328-2292-3260-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-2292-3260-4078.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-2292-3260-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
